'''Ivax''' and [[Kiax (god)|Kiax]] were a pair of ancient [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] trickster [[Deity/Legends|gods]]. The vast [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax]] and [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]] were thus named<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> in honor of the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigational]] havoc they played<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> with [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling through the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ivax and Kiax were created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
